name: Sun&Stars
source:
Meet Joshua, the protagonist of the story, as he dives into the hardships of senior high. He's not the brightest person out there , but he is trying his best to be who he wants to be. With friends by his side, and who knows? Maybe a handsome boyfriend. He will learn more and more what life has to offer. 

[Edited from [url=https://neon-glows.itch.io/sunstars]Itch.io[/url]]
